sources.measurement_method: Use the feature's 20-vertex outer ring, transform each lon/lat with the project README local approximation (x=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274deg), y=(lat-40.4274)*111040), and extrude as a simple massing; coordinates remain in campus world space.
sources.uncertainty: The Extrution field's units are undocumented; NUM_LEVELS and CountOfFLO conflict with the previous 11.4 m massing height and cannot establish actual vertical form. GIS Shape__Area (822.76 m2) conflicts with the polygon's 475.96 m2 area under the README approximation; the ring bounds and identity match the asset location, but area discrepancy remains unexplained. GIS geometry is not a survey and the documented local projection is approximate.
